tagline: VRGB games on the open substrate.
note: Dynamic manifest. The shell fetches this at load; add or retire a game here, no redeploy of the shell. Games are client-side ports of the bash ROMs in the arcade-games repo.

games.title: Chromafall
games.blurb: Falling color blocks. Each piece carries a hue; cleared lines emit their dominant color.

games.title: Maestro Chess
games.blurb: Real chess on the substrate. You play White by tap; a negamax CPU plays Black. The eval swatch tints warm when you lead, azure when the CPU does.

games.title: Chain Chomp
games.blurb: A dino grazing a provenance chain. Graze the hottest ferns first, build your chain multiplier, don't let a raptor break it.

games.title: Heat Trail
games.blurb: A cooling trail you keep fed. Your body sheds cold segments; eat to reheat and grow, or wither and die.

games.title: Unfold
games.blurb: Dimensional box-expansion platformer. Collect every jewel to open the exit; platforms cool and crumble under you.
